SIKAGROUT®-9550: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaGrout®-9550, November 2025, Version 02.03 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/k/sikagrout-9550.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaGrout®-9550 where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (November 2025, Version 02.03).
1.2 Product description. SikaGrout®-9550 is a ready-to-use, cement-based dry powder that forms a flowable, cohesive, and impermeable ultra-high performance cementitious (UHPC) grout when mixed with water. With advanced nano-engineered binder technology with blends of Portland, pozzolan, and special cements, achieves high compressive strength quickly. Offering excellent flowability and anti-washout properties, SikaGrout®-9550 is ideal for offshore wind turbine installations. Additionally, SikaGrout®-9550 is chloride-free, shrinkage-compensated, and highly resistant to water and aggressive ion penetration.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. SikaGrout®-9550 has been especially formulated for large scale, pump applications.
    - Grouting of wind turbine installations, e.g. foundations, monopiles, transition pieces of wind towers, tripods and jacket structures where very good fatigue resistance is required.
    - Grouting under very harsh conditions, e.g. offshore applications or below water grouting, at temperatures as low as 0°C.
    - All void filling from 25mm to 600mm thickness where high strength, high modulus is important.
    Contact the Technical Department of your local Sika office regarding any application required not mentioned here.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaGrout®-9550
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Ultra-high performance cementitious (UHPC) grout with advanced nanotechnology for offshore wind turbine installations
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Certificates and test reports.
    - DNV Type Approval Certificate no. TAK00001BC
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - EN 12390-7: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Product Information > Density (p.2).
    - EN 12390-3: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Compressive strength (p.2).
    - EN 206: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Compressive strength (p.2).
    - DIN 1045-2: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Compressive strength (p.2).
    - EN 12390-13: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Modulus of elasticity in compression (p.2).
    - ASTM C469: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Modulus of elasticity in compression (p.2).
    - EN 1015-11: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Flexural-strength (p.2).
    - ASTM C307: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Tensile strength (p.2).
    - ASTM C1698: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Shrinkage (p.2).
    - EN 445: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Expansion (p.2).
    - ASTM C512: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Technical Information > Creep (p.2).
    - ASTM C1202: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Chloride ion permeability (p.2).
    - ASTM C1437: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Application Information > Flowability (p.3).
    - EN 13395-2: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Application Information > Flowability (p.3).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Certified by Det Norske Veritas (DNV)
    - Ultra-high mean compressive strength ≥135MPa.
    - Ultra-high modulus for exceptional stiffening properties.
    - Quick return to service and removal of temporary supports due to high early strength build-up. ≥ 70 MPa @ 24hrs at 20°C
    - Excellent fatigue resistance.
    - Excellent strength gain at low temperatures @ 0°C at 24hrs
    - No wash-out during below water grouting
    - Pump able over long distances and large heights.
    - Good flowability
    - High early strength
    - Shrinkage compensated
    - No segregation or bleeding
    - Extended pot life
    - Widest range of application between 0 to 35oC without special precautions
    Contact the Technical Department of your local Sika office regarding any application at temperatures 35 oC to 45 oC.
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Density: 2.46 – 2.52 ton/m³ (EN 12390-7)
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Modulus of elasticity in compression: 53.000 N/mm²; Poisson's ratio: 0.19 (EN 12390-13) (ASTM C469)
    - Flexural-strength: 20.0 N/mm² (EN 1015-11)
    - Tensile strength: 8.0 N/mm² (ASTM C307)
    - Expansion: > 0.1% vol.-% (EN 445)
    - Chloride ion permeability: <100 (Negligible penetrability) (ASTM C1202)

2.10 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: SikaGrout®-9550 is supplied in special 25 kg bags and 500, 1000, 1500 kg big bags
    - Shelf life: 12 months from date of production
2.11 Storage conditions. Product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions away from direct sunlight and heat, not exceeding 40 oC. When stored under high temperature and high humidity conditions, the shelf life may be reduced.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (November 2025, Version 02.03) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (November 2025, Version 02.03) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Mixing ratio: 7.5 to 9.2 % water / powder ratio
    - Consumption: Approximately 440 liters per ton material
    - Pot Life: 3 hours
4.3 Layer thickness. 25 - 600 mm
    | Minimum | 25 mm (valid for anchor cage grout- |
    | ing) |
    | 75 mm (valid for annuluses in tubular / conical grouted connections) |
    | Maximum | 600 mm |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
4.4 Flowability.
    | Initial | 280 - 325 mm |
    | 1 hour | 260 - 280 mm |
    | Flow through | > 620 mm |
    | Flow cone | > 290 mm |
    | Flow class | f1 |
    | Classification according to DAfStb Richtlinie |

    Test method printed: (EN 13395-2)
4.5 Setting time.
    | Initial | Final |
    | 6 - 8 hours | 8-10 hours |
4.6 Notes on installation.
    - SikaGrout®-9550 has been especially formulated for use in specific applications. As such SikaGrout®-9550 should be installed by experienced fully trained contractors. Full application procedures are available on request.
    - Sands or other products that could affect the products properties must not be added.
4.7 Equipment.
    | Mixer type | Paddle mixer |
    | Mixing time | Approximately 6 minutes |
    | Application method | One continuous pour |
4.8 Mixing. SikaGrout®-9550 must be mixed using suitable grout mixing equipment combined with agitator for continuous large volume mixing. Volume capacity of equipment must be applicable to the volume of material being mixed for a continuous operation. Equipment trials must be considered to ensure product can be mixed satisfactory before full project application. Put most of the water required in the mixer and add slowly the grout material. Mix until a homogeneous mortar (3 to 4 minutes), add the remaining water and continue mixing for at least another 2 minutes until the required fluid or flowable consistency is obtained. Mix with potable water only. Do not add more water than the maximum specified.
4.9 Cleaning of equipment. Tools and spillages can be cleaned with water while SikaGrout®-9550 is still uncured. Once hardened, the material can only be removed mechanically.
4.10 Further documentation. Sika Method Statement: SikaGrout®-9550

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Material temperature. 0 °C min. / +35 °C max.
5.3 Ambient air temperature. 0 °C min. / +35 °C max.
5.4 Substrate temperature. 0 °C min. / +35 °C max.
5.5 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Density: 2.46 – 2.52 ton/m³ (EN 12390-7)
    - Compressive strength: Age | N/mm²; 1 day | > 70; 3 days | > 100; 7 days | > 115; 28 days | > 140; 91 days | > 145; 75 mm and 50 mm cubes; Age | N/mm²; 1 day | > 70; 3 days | > 95; 7 days | > 105; 28 days | > 130; 91 days | > 135; 150 x 300 mm cylinder; Exposure classes; XC4, XD3, XS3, XF3, XA2, WF; Early compressive strength class | A; Compressive strength class | > C100/115; Classification according to DAfStb Richtlinie (ASTM C109/C109M; EN 12390-3) (EN 12390-3) (DIN 1045-2; EN 206)
    - Modulus of elasticity in compression: 53.000 N/mm²; Poisson's ratio: 0.19 (EN 12390-13) (ASTM C469)
    - Flexural-strength: 20.0 N/mm² (EN 1015-11)
    - Tensile strength: 8.0 N/mm² (ASTM C307)
    - Shrinkage: Shrinkage class | SKVM 0; Classification according to DAfStb Ricthlinie; Autogenous shrinkage; Age | mm/m; 1 day | + 0.050; 56 days | - 0.130 (ASTM C1698)
    - Expansion: > 0.1% vol.-% (EN 445)
    - Chloride ion permeability: <100 (Negligible penetrability) (ASTM C1202)
    - Flowability: Initial | 280 - 325 mm; 1 hour | 260 - 280 mm; Flow through | > 620 mm; Flow cone | > 290 mm; Flow class | f1; Classification according to DAfStb Richtlinie (ASTM C1437) (EN 13395-2)
5.6 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.7 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaGrout®-9550, November 2025, Version 02.03, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/k/sikagrout-9550.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS SikaGrout®-9550, version 08/10/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/y/MSDS%20SikaGrout%20-%209550%20GHS7.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
